title: check: accept a record dated in its key's retirement second
description: Mark 2026-10-23 (from vouch-mzkw.4 question): git vouch check must accept a record whose date is the same second as its signing key's retirement, matching DESIGN's retire section ('a signature in the same second as a retirement is not a special case'). Today check rejects it as 'dated outside the validity of did:key:...' and sync exits 1. Record the rule in DESIGN.md.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-written test: key retired at T, record dated T signed by it passes check; dated T+1 fails. DESIGN states the boundary. Tests pass on 3.12 and 3.9.
